description: tests/map_interpolation.py: bilinear interpolation of each map (as SoLID_FieldMapB) minus the rzfield solution it was made from, at 3.75 M random points per map (3 M in the box around the iron, 0.75 M over the map grid), binned by the distance to the nearest iron/air interface of the mesh; air points within 2 cm of a coil are reported apart (near_coil). Maps: <name>.dat = the delivered map (nodes on iron faces take the air-side value), <name>_airside.dat = write_map.py --air-side, <name>_before.dat = the map before the air-side rule for nodes on iron faces (the side then depended on the mesh). CLEOv10: the POISSON map solenoid_CLEOv10.dat against CLEOv10.am solved by rzfield in the same box (includes the POISSON-rzfield difference, 0.2-5 G).
